Onn Hafiz: high-water DCs will not be approved. 42 DC projects worth RM164.45bn approved as of Q2 2025. Evaporative cooling requests deferred to 2027 (W.Media, May 2026). Johor committee guideline: cooling at least 1.8 L per kW per CPU, closed loops recycle water up to 6x (Malay Mail, 19 Aug 2025: https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2025/08/19/amid-fears-of-water-crisis-by-2030-johor-govt-sets-up-special-committee-to-vet-data-centres-impact-on-demand/188139).

Six rain-fed reservoirs, ~1.26m people. 10 DCs could need ~32 MLD by 2032 (8.4% of supply); Nongsa Digital Park 285 MW IT load needs ~29 MLD (our arithmetic: ~102,000 L/day per MW, higher than Johor estimates).

Residents blocked Nongsa Digital Park on 5 Oct 2026. BP Batam blames El Nino dry season; DCs draw from Duriangkang via dedicated pipeline while homes rely on depleted Nongsa reservoir. At least 16 hyperscale projects planned.
